author: Seth Godin
description: This is where empathy lies, and it’s an easy chasm to fall into. “I can’t imagine eating durian ice cream,” is not the same as “no one likes durian ice cream.” We fail as marketers, editors and project managers when we can’t find the empathy to bridge the gap. title: The gap between “I” and “no one”
